meta.description: WD-26. Daily 17:00 (1-day window) + weekly Friday 17:00 (7-day window) per-person and per-project activity digests over the work_activity spine — DISTINCT from the existing task-sla.json (due-date SLA escalation on core tasks) and digest-fanout.json (WA-bot digests). Read (workActivity.feed) -> group by person/project -> llm.summarize (one call per grouped person/project, never per activity row) -> notify (in-app only). The weekly trigger ALSO fires one workActivity.relink call (LD-16's deterministic relink sweep) so drift in auto-linking self-heals on a schedule, not just at ingest time. Every action is append/notify-only (LOW impact, DEF-3: no medium+ write anywhere in this flow). Scoped identity wf:wd-digests -> [workActivity.feed, projects.get, llm.summarize, notify, workActivity.relink]. Env: HUB_SERVICE_TOKEN, AGENCY_TENANT_ID.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: "2.0", id: 1, method: "tools/call", params: { name: "workActivity.feed", arguments: { tenantId: $env.AGENCY_TENANT_ID, since: $json.since, limit: 200 } } }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: "2.0", id: 2, method: "tools/call", params: { name: "projects.get", arguments: { tenantId: $env.AGENCY_TENANT_ID, projectId: $json.id } } }) }}

parameters.jsCode:
const prev = $json;
return [{ json: { ...prev, recipientId: prev.id, label: prev.id } }];

nodes.name: Build summary text (skip if no recipient)

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: "2.0", id: 3, method: "tools/call", params: { name: "llm.summarize", arguments: { text: $json.text } } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: "2.0", id: 4, method: "tools/call", params: { name: "notify", arguments: { tenantId: $env.AGENCY_TENANT_ID, recipientId: $json.recipientId, type: ($json.kind === 'project' ? 'wd_digest_project' : 'wd_digest_person'), payload: { period: $json.period, count: $json.count, label: $json.label, summary: $json.summary } } } }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: "2.0", id: 5, method: "tools/call", params: { name: "workActivity.relink", arguments: { tenantId: $env.AGENCY_TENANT_ID, limit: 100 } } }) }}
